title: HKU Science Foundation courses: two required integrated courses teaching method and concepts over computation
description: A sequence of two one-semester courses required of all incoming science students regardless of intended major, introduced at HKU in 2012. The first teaches the scientific method, logical and quantitative reasoning, and mathematics through "the formulation of problems but not calculations"; the second surveys physics, astronomy, earth sciences, chemistry and biology to give "an overview of natural science" with unifying concepts. The courses start with real-life problems, and exams present new situations rather than lecture tasks.
requirements: Required of all incoming science students irrespective of intended major
Shared teaching and assessment techniques including history of subject and exam items with new situations
target_learning_goals: broad integrated view of the sciences
examples: Course content listed includes scientific method, guesstimation, mathematical modelling, hypothesis testing, correlation and causation, regression, and predictions
